title: Sources: Netflix discussed adding streamers like Peacock and Fox One as it seeks to compete with YouTube and Roku in becoming a one-stop shop for TV content (John Koblin/New York Times)
summary: John Koblin / New York Times: Sources: Netflix discussed adding streamers like Peacock and Fox One as it seeks to compete with YouTube and Roku in becoming a one-stop shop for TV content — For years, Amazon has persuaded tens of millions of people to use its Prime Video app to subscribe to other services …
